ITEM 1 | Slice of bread, triangular wedge with a golden-brown toasted crust edge and a pale cream interior with fine grain and scattered darker seeds or specks; matte, dry-looking surface, holds its shape, sits at the upper middle of the plate, roughly 9 cm long along the crust and about 2 cm thick | 45
ITEM 2 | Watermelon, cut into irregular cubes and chunks, bright red flesh with slightly glossy, moist surface and small dark seeds visible in several pieces; firm, holds its shape, pieces roughly 2 to 3.5 cm across, clustered on the right side of the plate next to the bread | 110
